summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners filed a Form 6-K reporting ordinary share repurchases executed from 27-31 July 2026 under its existing EUR 1 billion buyback programme announced 17 February 2026. Purchases totalled 216,400 shares on US venues and 45,267 on London venues, at average prices around USD 107-111 and GBP 79-84, via Goldman Sachs. Repurchased shares will be cancelled. This is a routine periodic buyback disclosure, not a tender offer or special event, but it reflects an ongoing capital return programme.
